dimensions.assessment: Applies directly to the President, White House administrative staff, and specific congressional committee leaders and staff.
dimensions.evidence: The President shall submit to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs of the Senate and the Committee on Oversight and Government Reform of the House... a description of any activity... with an aggregate cost... of more than $1,000,000

dimensions.assessment: Mandates detailed project descriptions, staff reviews, and semiannual progress reports before major White House residence activities can be authorized.
dimensions.evidence: On publication in the Congressional Record of a statement by each Chairman... that the Chairman has received such information and reviewed such activity... the President is authorized

dimensions.assessment: Applies to projects costing more than $1,000,000, but does not allocate new federal funds or alter broader budget appropriations.
dimensions.evidence: with an aggregate cost from all sources of funding of more than $1,000,000

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 3 of the United States Code to add procedural oversight requirements for executive residence improvements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 105 of title 3, United States Code, is amended by adding at the end the following

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory amendment establishing an ongoing oversight and semiannual reporting process.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than June 1 and December 1 of each year, the President... shall submit... a progress report

missing_information: The frequency or total count of future White House improvement projects exceeding the threshold.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a formal congressional notification and review process for activities or improvements at the Executive Residence at the White House exceeding $1,000,000.
